name: What are the most common mistakes in backyard renovations?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common mistakes homeowners make during a backyard renovation?
mainEntity.text: What are the most common mistakes homeowners make during a backyard renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common backyard renovation mistakes are usually planning mistakes, not aesthetic ones. Homeowners often choose features before deciding how the yard should function, which leads to poor circulation and awkward placement. Another major mistake is ignoring drainage, especially in yards with slope or runoff issues. Permits and utility requirements are also easy to underestimate, particularly for patios, patio covers, outdoor kitchens, and pools. In small yards, overcrowding the space with too many features can make the result feel cramped instead of luxurious. It is also common to install finishes before finalizing gas, electrical, or irrigation routes, which creates costly rework later. The best way to avoid these problems is to start with a master plan and build in the correct order.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include skipping drainage planning, choosing features before setting the layout, underestimating permits, crowding too many elements into a small yard, and not planning utilities before hardscape is installed. These issues often cause expensive rework.
